architecture_summary: Modular React SPA. Pages in src/pages/. Shared components in src/components/. React Router v6 for navigation. Tailwind CSS for styling. No state management library (use React context for global state if needed).

tickets.title: Dashboard home page (screen_1_dashboard_home)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch screen_1_dashboard_home to React component. Extract reusable widgets (announcements, upcoming deadlines, quick actions) into separate components. Preserve exact layout, colors, spacing. Use Tailwind classes. No hardcoded data - fetch from API endpoints: /api/dashboard/summary, /api/announcements.
acceptance_criteria: Component renders pixel-perfect match to Stitch screen
Data fetched from API endpoints on mount
Error handling for failed API calls

tickets.title: Homework search page (screen_2_homework_search)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch screen_2_homework_search to React component. Implement search bar with filters (subject, due date range, status). Table display for results. Pagination controls. Extract search form and table row components. API endpoints: /api/homework/search (POST with filters), /api/homework/{id} for details.
acceptance_criteria: Search filters work with API integration

tickets.title: Calendar & exams schedule page (screen_3_calendar_exams_schedule)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch screen_3_calendar_exams_schedule to React component. Implement interactive calendar with exam/event markers. Month/week/day views. Event detail modal. Extract calendar component and event card. API endpoints: /api/calendar/events (GET with date range), /api/exams/schedule.
acceptance_criteria: Events fetched and displayed for selected date range
Event detail modal opens on click

tickets.title: Transaction detail page (detail_transaksi)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch detail_transaksi screen to React component. Display transaction details, payment status, receipt download. Extract transaction item component. API endpoint: /api/transactions/{id}.
acceptance_criteria: Error handling for failed API call

tickets.title: Shared UI components library
tickets.description: Create shared components used across multiple pages. Extract from existing screens: buttons, cards, modals, form inputs, badges, icons. Style with Tailwind. Document props in JSDoc. No business logic - pure presentational components.
acceptance_criteria: Storybook stories for each component (optional, add if time permits)

tickets.title: API service layer
tickets.description: Create API service layer. Centralize API calls, error handling, auth token management. Use fetch API (no axios). Base URL from environment variable. Implement request/response interceptors for auth token injection and error handling.

tickets.title: Global state management (React context)
tickets.description: Implement global state management for user auth, theme, notifications. Use React context. Create providers for auth, theme, notification. No Redux - overkill for current scope.
acceptance_criteria: Context providers wrap app at root level

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create app shell. Implement navigation bar with active state. Set up React Router v6 routes. Lazy load page components. Error boundary at root. Global styles and Tailwind config. Environment variables for API base URL.
acceptance_criteria: Tailwind config includes all design tokens
